residency_notes: BytePlus ModelArk exposes region-scoped endpoints for AP (Johor) and EU (Dublin); requests primarily route to the endpoint region but may spill to another region for scheduling. BytePlus says Customer Data processing may occur in Malaysia, Indonesia, and/or the EU/EEA, and content triggered by safety filters may be retained in Malaysia for 180 days. No general ZDR control is documented.
prompt_training_notes: BytePlus ModelArk says it processes customer data solely under customer instructions and will not use Customer Data for its own model training without prior customer authorization.
